title: Titanium Item
description: This mod add titan sword,titan ore etc.
body:
The Titanium Mod introduces a brand-new, powerful, and rare mineral to Minecraft: Titanium. It is a resource that sits perfectly between diamond and netherite, giving players a new objective during challenging deep-cave expeditions.

🌌 What’s in this version of the mod?
Titanium Ore: A new, incredibly hard block that generates exclusively deep underground in the Overworld (below Y-level 24). You need at least a diamond pickaxe to mine it!

Raw Titanium: The natural resource dropped when mining the ore. It works with the Fortune enchantment, allowing you to gather more material from a single vein.

Smelting Process: You can smelt Raw Titanium in a standard furnace or blast furnace to create shiny, metallic-graphite Titanium Ingots.

Titanium Sword: A legendary, incredibly durable weapon (boasting 2,000 uses!) that deals massive damage and easily handles the toughest monsters. The sword can be repaired on an anvil using titanium ingots.

🚀 Future Plans:
The mod is constantly evolving! Upcoming updates will include:

A full set of titanium mining tools (including a powerful pickaxe with a mining level of 4).

Heavy titanium armor with unique properties (knockback resistance).
